extraWaitRule: At each decision, add a WAIT wakeup at observed time + observed PREPARE duration, if within the frozen horizon. Existing earlier events still interrupt WAIT/CONTINUE. No material or operation is created by the timer.
filtering: Off-horizon PREPARE is retained in both production spaces. Its removal is tested only as a separate tiny exhaustive ablation.
scope: Four counterexample cells; prepared/autonomous X/Y; identical exact solver for Next H=1 and Multi H=2. Each timing model uses the same timer rule in forecast branches and actual execution.
